title: EPS update result
text: The purpose of the EPS update result information element is to specify the result of the associated updating procedure
The EPS update result information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.3.13.1 and table 9.9.3.13.1
The EPS update result is a type 1 information element

fields.name: Spare
fields.description: Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: EPS update result value
fields.description: 000: TA updated; 001: combined TA/LA updated; 010: TA updated and ISR activated (NOTE); 011: combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated (NOTE); All other values are reserved

notes: Bits 6 to 8 in octet 5 are spare and shall be coded as zero if included
Values 'TA updated and ISR activated' and 'combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated' are used only for a UE supporting also A/Gb or Iu mode

content.table_title: Table 9.9.3.13.1: EPS update result information element
columns: EPS update result value (octet 1, bit 1 to 3)
rows: combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated (NOTE)
Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero.
Values "TA updated and ISR activated" and "combined TA/LA updated and ISR activated" are used only for a UE supporting also A/Gb or Iu mode.
